bio: Clarus was only an acolyte until he translated a page that revealed to be from the Varkis Codex, a tome of a forgotten Titan. He now searches for other pages, but not alone – the Knights of Malice hound his every step. Still, he will not rest. He will find the truth, even if it costs him his life.
